title: WhyTheDiff
lede: Follow public code changes back to why they happened.
summary: An application that follows public GitHub code, history, and discussions to produce cited explanations. Findings distinguish documented reasons, inferences, and unresolved questions.
highlights: Cited reports that separate documented, inferred, and unresolved findings
Bounded job queue, checkpoint recovery, and owner-scoped history
Quote and grounding checks before a claim survives

title: Eight-Thousanders RAG Assistant
lede: Answers over a focused corpus, with the retrieval exposed.
summary: A focused retrieval assistant for a mountain-climbing corpus, pairing dense and keyword search with reciprocal rank fusion and reranking, plus a 20-question evaluation harness.
highlights: Dense and keyword retrieval fused with reciprocal rank fusion
Cross-encoder reranking to narrow evidence before generation

title: Research Briefing Agent
lede: Web research that survives being interrupted.
summary: A tool-based research workflow with checkpoints, session memory, execution budgets, and recovery when work is interrupted.
highlights: Validated tool dispatch through a typed registry
SQLite checkpoints that resume a run after a forced stop
Step and token budgets with no-progress stopping
